title: Build the Crash Timeline
description: Correlate orders-api crashes in /var/log/syslog: count them and timestamp the first.
scenario: orders-api keeps dying on the staging box and the post-mortem needs a timeline. In the extracted system log /var/log/syslog, every crash of the service appears as an 'orders-api[N]: Segmentation fault' line. Count the crashes and timestamp the first one, writing `crash-count=<n>` and `first-crash=<timestamp>` to /home/intern/crash-report.txt.
symptoms: /var/log/syslog contains systemd unit failures and the app's own output
Crashes manifest as 'Segmentation fault' lines from the orders-api process
The post-mortem needs the crash count and the first crash timestamp

hints.title: Correlate two log sources
hints.content: systemd's 'Failed with result' lines and the app's own 'Segmentation fault' lines tell one story — grep each and compare timestamps.

hints.title: Count precisely
hints.content: `grep -c 'Segmentation fault' /var/log/syslog` counts the crashes. Check the preceding lines to confirm the process is orders-api.

hints.title: First occurrence
hints.content: Syslog is chronological: the first crash is `grep 'Segmentation fault' /var/log/syslog | head -1`, and its timestamp is the first three fields.
